analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for the 4th consecutive day. RSI at 49.9 remains in neutral territory, and MACD histogram shows only a slight improvement. While both the 5-day and 20-day lows are rising, forming a Higher Low pattern, the 5-day and 20-day highs are also declining, creating a mixed pattern of both Higher Low and Lower High. The ADX at 18.2 indicates a weak trend, lacking directional conviction. The 1.31x volume adds some weight to price movements, but the absence of clear direction warrants continued observation.
